Note(s):
a) Prevailing price is defined as the average price at which any basic necessity has been sold in a given area.
This is computed as the average price using arithmetic mean formula.
b) n/a - not available in the market/establishment
c) Price per Unit
- Agri-fishery commodities except egg: Peso per Kilogram
- Eggs: Peso per Piece
- Salt and Sugar: Peso per Kilogram
- Cooking Oil: Peso per Liter
d) Covered markets
